STRONGEST_PROVEN_FINDING=FoldOverlayService's latest-only control->main hinge bridge can erase already-accepted intermediate precise samples that Fold7ContinuityController needs for multi-sample close intent and opening-reversal generation/cycle invalidation. The Samsung pipeline already has sourceUptime but drops it before the controller, which later substitutes main processing time. Reduced source-faithful tests show deterministic missed close intent and stale old-cycle survival; exhaustive 33,300-burst model found 13,239 full-delivery original-cycle invalidations missed by latest-only. A min/max/final compressor was rejected (85 misses). Bounded ordered source-time batch matched full delivery with 0 misses/0 signature mismatches in all non-overflow exhaustive + 100,000 fixed-seed random tests; fail-closed overflow retained unsafe old cycle 0 times in a 100,000 long-burst model, at the cost of conservative extra invalidations. Pure Kotlin mailbox prototype compiles and passes 5/5 checks. STRONGEST_REMAINING_UNCERTAINTY=real Fold7 sample-rate/main-stall incidence, capacity selection, overflow UX, and combined behavior after Gen3 V3 plus semantic-reclose/angle-authority integration. DEVICE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=YES. MANUAL_INTEGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED=YES. Integration sequencing: establish verified post-V3 CURRENT main first, rebase this design, combine idempotently with semantic device-state re-close cancellation, run repository Gradle/fault tests, then physical Fold7 TransitionLab stress plan.
